_comment: Golden vectors generated from iphone/swing_metrics.py, the tested reference. The Swift port must reproduce every value here exactly. Regenerate with: python3 iphone/gen_swing_vectors.py

motionStart.name: clean swing from a settled address
swing taken straight out of walking
deep pause at the top must not read as address
pause at the top long enough to qualify
address beyond the 2 s lookback bound
all quiet, no motion at all

transition.name: window one sample under the boundary

analyse.name: no address, must not fabricate a tempo

threshold.name: window overflows and drops the oldest

verdict.expect: slow backswing relative to your downswing
slow backswing relative to your downswing
